name: 32618-decode-30ba3b-pp4
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 -- four GPUs of one node, no host-to-host fabric. Absolute milliseconds are a property of this box.
parallelism: PP=4, TP=1, DP=1, `mp` executor, one in-process vLLM engine driven by guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 128 streams, 10% warmup and 10% cooldown, bounded at 1024 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 2 prompt tokens and 512 output tokens, fixed (min = max = mean), no prefix buckets, ignore_eos set so every generation runs its full 512 tokens.
purpose: A long-form story generator writing 512-token completions from tiny prompts for 128 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: 8bdd3979d8c2f15feb475485ba1af1917cefbe5a -- a commit, not a release, so it is a source
# checkout named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`. guidellm drives the engine in-process through the
# `vllm_python` backend rather than over HTTP, so no host or port appears here.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8

pipeline-parallel-size: 4
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned rather than left to resolve: the default flips to `ray` if ray happens to be initialised
# with a placement group in the process.
distributed-executor-backend: mp

async-scheduling: true

# Must match the 128 concurrent streams in scenario.json, so the run saturates its own cap.
max-num-seqs: 128

# The engine default, written out so the KV pool cannot drift with a future default.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
